semanticCoverage: Not a completed full-chain catalog verification. Every generated overlap transition is classified; unresolved lexical dependencies remain candidates.

findings.explanation: Migration 002 declares text[]; 020 assigns JSONB. First unchanged-chain failure after 19 files.
findings.repair: Explicit compatibility path only; historical bytes preserved.

findings.explanation: JSONB column receives text[] in two assignments. Confirmed after the migration-020 compatibility correction.
findings.repair: Two exact literal conversions; all strategy parameters retained.

findings.explanation: Same zero-argument RPC changes TABLE result to JSONB without DROP. Real PostgreSQL rejects the replacement.
findings.repair: Exact signature DROP without CASCADE plus original body/grants, in one compatibility transaction. No reset invocation.

findings.explanation: 050 consumes entry_enabled before 074 creates it. Original migration numbers do not reflect timestamp order.
findings.repair: Explicit compatibility prelude copies only the additive false-default declaration; full 050 transaction remains blocked by its status constraint.

findings.explanation: 072 permits connected/disconnected/degraded/protection_risk/monitor_risk/recovery_risk. 050 INSERT seeds configured/monitor_pending/placeholder. PostgreSQL checks the INSERT before ON CONFLICT updates, even for existing providers.
findings.repair: No constraint widening or seed-state rewrite. Resolve canonical status semantics and online fingerprints in a separate reviewed repair before proceeding.

findings.explanation: Standalone prepared SQL and directory preflight/apply scripts overlap. Select one reviewed path; never recursively apply all or promote into automatic migrations.
Alternate-v2 identities and combined archival schema are inventory-only for this project, never part of this automatic chain.

Chronological rebuilds replace URLs/auth headers and remove one-minute proof jobs. Old URL/GUC/header forms must not be replayed as new activation instructions. Function existence is insufficient proof of correct current auth/config.

Two preserved main-triggered Edge deploy workflows can duplicate deployments and select project refs differently. This PR does not merge or deploy; release operator must choose/review automation before any main merge.
